about: Taco Cam: own iPhone-as-USB-webcam app (Iriun-like, plus 0.5x) feeding OBS as the "Taco Cam" camera

runs.title: Team build, first iPhone build, first real-phone run
runs.summary: A nodeterm team built the iPhone app, PC engine and window; a follow-up session unblocked the push, did the checker review, built and installed the app and ran it on the real phone.

sessions.did: Settled choices with the user, wrote CONTRACT.md and the station briefs
Swift app, XcodeGen project, CI workflow, install guide; push refused (gh token lacked workflow scope)
Protocol, USB link, decoder, pipeline, virtual camera, fake phone; 185 tests; vcam verified bit-exact
tkinter control window, settings, README, launchers; 60 app tests

stages.name: Checker + real phone
stages.note: the Checker station never started; this session did its job

sessions.did: Swift review, 4 iOS fixes, first green build, IPA via iloader, real iPhone 11 working, 4K benchmark, Whatnot settings

events.text: Waiting for the user to grant the GitHub workflow permission

lessons: Check gh auth status for the workflow scope before a team run that must push a workflow file
Sideloadly login broken by Apple since 2026-10-21 (-80046); iloader works
OBS stream settings came from Whatnot's own tool: check where settings came from before suggesting changes

runs.title: Public repo, own icon, presets, expiry warning, back-camera holds
runs.summary: One session made the repo public, gave the window its own icon and shortcuts, added presets with hotkeys and OBS scene following, the 7-day expiry warning, and fixed locks on the iPhone's combined back camera.

sessions.did: Public MIT repo (history scrubbed), icon + shortcuts, presets/hotkeys/Follow OBS, app expiry, anti-flicker, hold fallbacks for the Dual Wide camera; 2 iPhone builds

lessons: AVFoundation virtual cameras (Dual Wide / Triple) refuse lens position, custom exposure and custom white-balance gains: check before promising manual controls
Tk on Windows: iconbitmap plus iconphoto gives a blank icon; set an AppUserModelID or pythonw apps share one taskbar button

runs.title: Clips, start with Windows, battery warning, scanner feed
runs.summary: One session added save-the-hit clips, start with Windows and a battery warning, then fed the Whatnot card scanner straight from Taco Cam and found 4K hurt its card finding.

sessions.did: clips.py, shortcuts.py, battery warning, framefeed v1->v2, Whatnot TacoCamSource + 1080p fix, Card Scanner shortcut

lessons: Measure what the consumer actually uses before upgrading the source: the scanner reads cards at 420x612 and tunes detection at 1080p, so 4K only hurt
Shared-memory frames: double-buffer and do the conversion on the writer, or readers collide with writes
Never write binary-looking escapes through bash heredocs: they became real NUL bytes

runs.title: Smooth zoom, pre-show check, phone pause reasons
runs.summary: One session: answered a terminal-glitch question (made fixterm + /fix-terminal), suggested improvements, then built the user's picks 1-3 on the iPhone and PC and built the new IPA.

sessions.did: zoom_glide_s (iPhone ramp + Zoom speed), STATE interrupted + red status line, precheck.py + check window + check when OBS goes live; 295 tests; GitHub build 40406780074

lessons: Commit messages from PowerShell: write them to a file and use git commit -F <file> (piping a here-string to -F - failed).
